sources.entry: Karaoke Eternal - Host awesome karaoke parties where everyone can easily find and queue songs from their phone's browser. The player is also fully browser-based with support for MP3+G, MP4 and WebGL visualizations. (Source Code) ISC Docker/Nodejs
Karaoke Forever - Host awesome karaoke parties where everyone can queue songs from their phone's browser. Plays MP3+G and MP4 with WebGL visualizations.
Karaoke Eternal | Host your own karaoke party

summary.one_liner: Karaoke Eternal is a self-hosted karaoke party server where guests queue songs from their phone's browser and a browser-based player plays MP3+G, MP4 and WebGL visualizations.
summary.what_it_does: The server hosts a web app for guests and serves your media files, and it is described as running on a range of hardware including Windows PCs, Macs, and devices like a Raspberry Pi or Synology NAS. Guests join by QR code or guest account and search and queue songs from a mobile browser app. A separate player is meant to run fullscreen on the machine handling audio and video for a room. The player plays MP3+G (including zipped files), MP4 videos, and music-synced WebGL visualizations with automatic lyrics background removal. It supports multiple simultaneous rooms or queues, optionally password-protected, and uses dynamic queues to keep turns fair. The README states there are no ads or telemetry, and microphones are not required because the player only outputs music.
use_cases: host a karaoke party at home
let guests queue songs from their phones
play MP3+G karaoke files on a TV or PC
run multiple karaoke rooms with separate queues
self-host a karaoke jukebox on a Raspberry Pi or NAS
play karaoke MP4 videos with lyrics
how_to_run: Make sure you have Node.js v24 or later
Look for 'Web server running at' in the output for the server URL
notable: Guests queue songs from their phone browser with no app install, joining via QR code or guest accounts
Player is fully browser-based and plays MP3+G (including zipped), MP4, and WebGL visualizations
Multiple simultaneous rooms or queues, optionally password-protected
Dynamic queues designed to keep parties fair
Microphones are not required because the player only outputs music
caveats: Contributions are limited in scope; the maintainers ask contributors to discuss major features on Discord first
Development requires Node.js v24 or later
The README says installation has several methods but does not detail them in the text provided
